data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2 (partial): every in-tree reference to llm-api-call.sh has been updated to a shim invocation (merge-to-main-pr.sh already uses _PLUGIN_ROOT-relative paths; this task adds shim-semantics documentation)
- DD3 (partial): merge-to-main-pr.sh invocations documented as shim-mediated so no broken references remain after deletion

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh

## Current State
merge-to-main-pr.sh has 3 locations that default to llm-api-call.sh via _PLUGIN_ROOT-relative paths:
- Line 700: local _llm_cmd="${_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"
- Line 993: local _llm_cmd="${_RESOLVE_CONFLICTS_LLM_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"
- Line 1118: local _llm_cmd="${_REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"

These already use _PLUGIN_ROOT-relative paths (correct pattern). They need shim-semantics annotations to document:
1. That llm-api-call.sh will become a compat-shim (S6 creates the wrapper)
2. That the env var override (_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD, etc.) is the test isolation mechanism

Additionally, the env var documentation block (around line 687, line 1109) should be updated to note the shim.

## Implementation Steps
1. Read plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
2. For each of the 3 _llm_cmd defaults, add a comment on the line ABOVE:
   - Line 700: "# compat-shim: llm-api-call.sh is a general LLM helper; post-S3 this defaults to a compat wrapper (S6 creates it). Override: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD."
   - Line 993: "# compat-shim: llm-api-call.sh will be a compat wrapper post-S3. Override: _RESOLVE_CONFLICTS_LLM_CMD."
   - Line 1118: "# compat-shim: llm-api-call.sh will be a compat wrapper post-S3. Override: _REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD."
3. Update the env var documentation block (lines ~687, ~1109) to note "default: llm-api-call.sh compat wrapper (S6 creates it)"
4. Do NOT change any default paths, logic, or function signatures — annotation only

## Verification
The test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh test uses _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD env var override to stub llm-api-call.sh. This test requires NO changes — the env var mechanism is preserved.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py 2>/dev/null || echo "lint-ok"
- [ ] compat-shim annotation present near _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD default
  Verify: grep -q "compat-shim" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] All 3 LLM dispatch defaults annotated
  Verify: grep -c "compat-shim" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'
- [ ] No logic changes (function signatures unchanged)
  Verify: git diff HEAD -- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -v '^+#' | grep -v '^+$' | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 > 0)}'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Annotate merge-to-main-pr.sh LLM dispatch defaults as pending compat-shim invocations
